results.name: Anonymous public clip catalog is real and owner management requires login
The private media fixture binds its publisher to the actual owning channel
Clip creation requires the source owner with valid CSRF and Origin
Private clip management rejects a previous cookie-account scope
Clip intervals reject negative, too short, too long, out-of-source and fractional millisecond values
A selected nonzero interval becomes a distinct verified public MP4 without modifying its VOD source
An exact request UUID returns the same durable clip receipt without another file
A reused request UUID cannot silently change its immutable creation snapshot
Another account cannot read or alter a publisher private clip
Anonymous global and channel discovery expose public clip metadata without management request identities
Public clip media supports exact HEAD and single or suffix byte ranges
Invalid clip ranges return 416 without unrestricted fallback
The trimmed MP4 has its own approximately six-second timeline starting near zero
Decoded clip frames correspond to the requested source interval instead of replaying the untrimmed source
Editing visible metadata does not invalidate the original UUID receipt snapshot
A publisher private choice blocks new anonymous detail, media and HEAD requests
Stale clip revisions cannot overwrite a newer publisher visibility choice
Real clip cursors separate published rows and remain bound to their filter context
A private parent VOD immediately gates all new public clip discovery and media requests
A private source VOD cannot start a new clip preparation
Republishing a parent restores only clips whose own visibility is still public
An already prepared clip remains playable when its parent physical archive is absent but the parent DB remains public
Publisher clip withdrawal remains possible without the source physical archive
A missing prepared clip is unavailable and never exposes public metadata or bytes
Clip visibility can be revoked using only the DB while its own file is unavailable
Returning a missing clip file never overrides a publisher private choice
An actual clip storage failure stays non-public with a recoverable receipt
Retry prepares the same failed clip and preserves its private choice
Redis login, public clip metadata and actual prepared bytes survive API restart
Actual clip creation, management, anonymous playback and responsive UI pass
Development StrictMode reads actual public clips without mutations
The exact tested JAR remains immutable during media preparation and restart

fixture: Dedicated MediaMTX + one tiny H.264/AAC source + actual finalized VOD + independently encoded clip + immutable Spring JAR + headless Edge
limits: One PC loopback/headless Edge only; mobile widths are emulated, not phones
No Caddy HTTPS, external network, long-run or load/capacity verification
